purpose.statement: Give Studio Chat Claude hands over Barkpark and the workday shell needed to use them safely.
purpose.why: The larger goal is Studio Claude Chat — provide one durable agent workday with reliable input, capabilities, task tools, and graceful degradation. The concrete problem was that the system lacked a capability moat, loopback MCP actions, needs-you flow, notifications, and evidence that session branching works. Shipping eight coordinated slices around capabilities, MCP, chips, inbox, notifications, and fork probing was the correct intervention because a wave-level contract can join the agent runtime and human workday while keeping unsupported providers trigger-gated. If omitted, Chat cannot complete or surface real project work and silently degrades when integrations are absent.
